description: Four computer riders race every course in Game.courses, all laps, on a fixed seed. Every rider finishes each race with no crash, no disqualification and at most 3 missed buoys, and the game raises no engine error or warning. Each course's lap times, misses and crashes per rider are printed (game: lines on stderr).

steps.name: one race per course in Game.courses
every rider finished every course cleanly
